DEVOUT-UNSHEATHED.title: Unsheathed
DEVOUT-UNSHEATHED.description:
[gold]Ethereal[/gold].
When played with a 0[img]res://Devout/images/charui/text_energy.png[/img] cost, it [gold]Exhausts[/gold]. Otherwise, it returns to the [gold]Hand[/gold].
DEVOUT-ENTHRALLING.title: Enthralling
DEVOUT-ENTHRALLING.description: If this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], it must be played before other cards.
DEVOUT-TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
DEVOUT-TEMPORARY.description: At the end of the turn, this Power is removed and the card is sent into the discard pile.
DEVOUT-RHYTHMIC.title: Rhythmic
DEVOUT-RHYTHMIC.description: This card's effectiveness scales by [blue]1[/blue] for every [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] you have.
